entries.e1ffa345270509da: The company, a [[term:holding-company|holding company]], together with Resona Bank, Ltd., Saitama Resona Bank, Ltd., Kansai Mirai Bank, Ltd. and Minato Bank, Ltd., makes up the “Resona Group.” As of March 31, 2026, all four of these banks are [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]] in which the company holds 100.0% of the voting rights. As of March 31, 2026, the group had 30 domestic consolidated subsidiaries, 3 overseas consolidated subsidiaries and 6 equity-method affiliates. These companies provide financial services including banking and trust business, as well as credit card business, venture capital business, factoring business, investment management business, investment advisory and agency business and leasing business. This section is not a reportable segment, and no amounts are printed for this group of companies alone (this does not mean zero). For this reason, it is placed after the three segments.
entries.f42cee8f68bc9cca: This division mainly targets corporate customers and focuses on activities that support business growth, such as corporate lending, asset management using trusts, real estate business, corporate pensions and business succession. The Resona Group divides its group business divisions into the “Personal Division,” “Corporate Division” and “Markets Division” for business division management accounting, and these three are its [[term:segment|segments]]. Because the income structure of banking differs from that of general companies, segment earnings are managed on the basis of earnings indicators commonly used in banking, and no breakdown of revenue from external customers is disclosed. For this reason, the three divisions are listed in descending order of their segment earnings indicator (for the fiscal year ended March 2026: Corporate Division, Personal Division, Markets Division). The Corporate Division and Personal Division also include figures for loan guarantee companies and other consolidated subsidiaries.
